en: As the days go by, Tomás gains confidence.
es: A medida que pasan los días, Tomás gana confianza.
why: Things changing little by little take a medida que.

en: Rosa cooks while she talks on the phone.
es: Rosa cocina al tiempo que habla por teléfono.
why: Two actions at the same moment are al tiempo que.

en: Vale smiled at the same time as she shook his hand.
es: Vale sonrió al tiempo que le daba la mano.
why: Just two things at once, no gradual change.

en: As we learn more words, we understand more.
es: A medida que aprendemos más palabras, entendemos más.
why: More and more goes with a medida que.

en: Hernando drinks his coffee while he reads the paper.
es: Hernando toma su tinto al tiempo que lee el periódico.

en: Tomás cleaned while listening to music.
es: Tomás limpiaba al tiempo que escuchaba música.
why: Doing two things at the same time.
